observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' carries high-arousal urgency to purge information, a forceful directive register with negative valence toward the target knowledge.
Imperative 'Remove' with sweeping scope 'all knowledge' sustains the same urgent, forceful purge directive — high arousal, negative valence toward the named items.
Flat declarative correcting the record — low arousal, negative valence in the form of resigned correction; the urgency of the prior directives has settled into a blunt factual negation.
